name: Lost Friends 2 -Reason for Tears-
source:
Ricardo is but a young man who dreams of becoming a splendid gardener.

By day, he works as a helper in a lord's mansion, learning the basics from the gardeners who are his seniors. By night, he heads to a secret place where he deepens his bonds with a peculiar-looking friend. Switching between the normal and the abnormal, he was satisfied with his daily life.

One day, the lord's son singles him out to be his playmate. His enjoyable days as a helper were turned upside down, as he was slowly but surely forced into an uncomfortable life as a boring 'playmate'.

What was gained, and what was lost?
'Friendship' and 'promises' intertwine, and his daily life begins to be encroached on by a fruitless miracle.

[Translated from the [url=https://uzumeya.wixsite.com/lost/2]official website[/url]]
translation:
里卡多是个年轻人，梦想成为优秀园丁。

白天，他在领主宅邸做帮工，向园丁前辈学习基础知识。夜晚，他前往秘密地点，与外表奇特的朋友加深羁绊。在正常与异常之间切换，他对日常生活感到满足。

某天，领主的儿子选中他做玩伴。他愉快的帮工生活被彻底颠覆，逐渐被迫过上不舒服的生活，成为无聊的“玩伴”。

获得了什么，又失去了什么？

“友谊”与“约定”交织，徒劳奇迹开始侵蚀他的日常生活。

[译自[url=https://uzumeya.wixsite.com/lost/2]官方网站[/url]]
